senses.gloss: m. pl. (נְקַט) objects held in the hand while making oath.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 5:1">Tosef. Snh. V, 1</cite> [read:] <he>דור לי … בקיטא ובמ׳ דנקיטי</he> if the contestant says, swear to me by thy life, or by the object or objects which I hold (v. <cite ref="S01533"><he>קָנָה</he></cite>); Y. ib. III, beg. 21ᵃ (corr. acc.).
